motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Minimize transitions when requested by the operating system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action for adding an appointment.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 39px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; background: var(--forest); font: 700 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #23634e; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9ef81; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action that does not compete with booking.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { min-height: 35px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #dce5dd; border-radius: 6px; color: #526159; background: #fff; font: 700 9px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { border-color: #a8b8ac; background: #f8faf7; } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9ef81; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact filtering input for the schedule.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input aria-label="Search appointments" placeholder="Search appointments" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; height: 34px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #e1e7e1; border-radius: 5px; color: #7b8981; background: #fff; } .ds-search svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #202b27; background: transparent; font: 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #779a7b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #e5efe3; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: Active workspace section in the forest navigation rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { min-height: 43px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #12382f; background: #d9ef81; font: 700 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #e5f6a4; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9ef81; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Appointment State Chip
components.description: Readable state paired with a subdued role tint.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 21px; align-items: center; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 4px; color: #356548; background: #e7f2e6; font: 700 8px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Schedule Ticket
components.description: One selectable row holds time, pet, service, staff, and state together.
components.css: .ds-ticket { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 59px; grid-template-columns: 62px minmax(100px, 1.4fr) minmax(90px, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 7px 15px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ec; color: #293a31; background: #fff; text-align: left; font: 10px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ticket:hover { background: #f8faf7; } .ds-ticket:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d9ef81; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-ticket time { color: #335144; font: 600 16px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-ticket small { padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 4px; color: #356548; background: #e7f2e6; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
The interface treats the appointment as a working ticket rather than a detached calendar cell. Time, service, pet, responsible person, staff assignment, and current state travel together so reception can scan a busy day without losing the care context.

The system pairs a practical work surface with a neighborhood-clinic palette: deep forest anchors navigation, white and a cool green-tinted canvas hold dense information, and coral, blue, lime, and yellow distinguish operational states. The visual language comes from clear labels, short rows, and a restrained type contrast, not faux paper or decorative medical imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Distinct color roles paired with readable state labels.
Dense schedule rows balanced by an unhurried page rhythm.
Clear synthetic-data notices wherever demonstration content appears.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a state; readable text always names it.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for hierarchy and DM Sans for all operational detail; do not introduce a third display voice.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Separate operational surfaces with a fine border or a tonal shift, not a stack of shadows.

dos: Do keep status text visible beside its color treatment.
Do place service, pet, time, and assigned professional in the same appointment row.
Do label synthetic records and unconnected capabilities wherever they appear.
Do retain the full keyboard focus outline and reduced-motion preference.
donts: Don't make color the only way to recognize a booking state.
Don't present demonstration notes as a real medical history or reminder.
Don't replace the operational ticket list with decorative metric cards or faux-paper textures.
